sloka: प्रास कार्मुक बिभ्रद्भिर् युवभिर् मृष्ट कुण्डलैः ।अप्रमादिभिर् एक अग्रैः स्वनुरक्तैः अधिष्ठिताम् ॥२-१६-२॥
transliteration: prāsa kārmuka bibhradbhir yuvabhir mṛṣṭa kuṇḍalaiḥ ।apramādibhir eka agraiḥ svanuraktaiḥ adhiṣṭhitām ॥2-16-2॥

translations.english: Sumantra, who was conversant with ancient traditions, passed through the entrance of the inner apartment full of people and reached the sparsely crowded courtyard. There alert, loyal young men were attentively guarding the frontyard, armed with spears and bows and wearing shining earrings.
translations.hindi: उन्होंने जाते ही पहले बड़े विनीतभाव से पिता के चरणों में माथा नवाया और फिर माता कैकेयी को बड़ी प्रणाम किया
